prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good kids’ martial arts school in **St. Peters, MO** is **World Martial Arts Academy**, which offers dedicated kids’ classes with beginner-friendly age groupings in St. Peters.[1][8][13]

Other solid options to consider are **All Star Karate** and **Gracie Barra St. Peters**. All Star Karate emphasizes a structured, encouraging environment and offers a free introductory program, while Gracie Barra says it offers kids’ jiu-jitsu programs in St. Peters.[5][11][7]

If you want the best fit, I’d narrow it by your child’s age and goals:
- **Ages 4–6 / traditional structure:** World Martial Arts Academy or All Star Karate.[8][11]
- **Ages 7–11 / confidence and discipline:** World Martial Arts Academy or All Star Karate.[8][11]
- **Grappling / jiu-jitsu focus:** Gracie Barra St. Peters.[3][7]

A practical way to choose is to visit 2–3 schools, watch a class, and ask about instructor experience, cleanliness, class size, and whether they offer a trial class or intro program.[6]
